purpose: Teach: 宅急便/鼻水/一戸建て/仮眠/鉄板/年越し/着地/日向

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お豆の、本気で、絶対、宅急便、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、葵のお店に、絶対、届けてもらったわ
lines.en: Aoi, you seriously got those beans delivered to your shop — that was so thoughtful of you.
lines.style: Warm and genuinely delighted. Open attack, bright lift on 'beans.' Light, conversational pace. A moment of real appreciation in the voice.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。葵、本気で、絶対、最近、絶対、ちょっと、絶対、鼻水、絶対、出るわよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yeah, well, I've actually been getting a little runny nose lately, you know?
lines.style: Self-deprecating, slightly deflecting from the compliment. Wry undertone — not bitter, just matter-of-fact about the less-romantic details of work. Conversational, almost amused.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、いつか、絶対、一戸建て、絶対、お店、絶対、開きたいよね、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: You know, I'd really love to open my own standalone shop someday. I'm genuinely impressed by how you're moving toward that.
lines.style: Soft, thoughtful opening. Sincere admiration underneath — not flattering, just honest observation. Slower pace, dreamy quality. Trailing warmth at the end.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 仕込みの合間、本気で、絶対、葵、絶対、ちょっと、絶対、仮眠、絶対、取ってるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I've been catching quick naps between prep work — it's the only way I manage it.
lines.style: Straightforward and practical, no drama. Even delivery — stating fact without complaint. A hint of quiet determination beneath the tiredness. Brief, matter-of-fact.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵の、本気で、絶対、鉄板、絶対、人気メニュー、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、頼みたいわ
lines.en: I'd really love to order one of your signature dishes next time — the ones that always sell out.
lines.style: Genuine eagerness with a soft undertone of longing. Bright but not performative. The voice of someone who clearly loves what you make and wants to experience it fully.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、年越し、絶対、お店で、絶対、特別営業、絶対、するよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Actually, we're doing special New Year's Eve service at the shop this year.
lines.style: Animated, a little proud. Lighter, quicker pace — there's energy in this announcement. The lift of someone sharing something they're genuinely excited about.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵の新店舗の、本気で、絶対、着地、絶対、地点、絶対、もう、絶対、決まったの?メイちゃん
lines.en: Wait — has the location for your new shop actually been decided already?
lines.style: Curious, leaning in slightly. Quick, engaged opening. A question asked with genuine investment in the answer — you care about where this goes.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵のお店の窓辺の、本気で、絶対、日向、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、お気に入りよね
lines.en: That sunny spot by the window at your current shop — that's become my favorite place to sit, you know.
lines.style: Warm and close, almost intimate. Gentle pace. The voice of someone sharing a small, genuine memory. Slight trailing softness — the comfort of a familiar moment.
